The '''Whistler encryption module''' was an [[Encryption module/Legends|encryption module]] that was produced by [[Carbanti United Electronics/Legends|Carbanti United Electronics]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] installed a Whistler encryption module into a [[Chedak Communications|Chedak]] [[Frequency Agile subspace transceiver/Legends|Frequency Agile subspace transceiver]] that was fitted to his [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].<ref name="EGWT" />
